publicSourceBase.rule: Apply public S1 full patch to exact port SDL archive before S2; the Stdlib preimage is the S1 postimage, not pristine upstream.

reconstructionOrder: Verify public candidate.4 outer source archive and nested port SDL archive hashes.
Apply the complete public S1 patch, including its Stdlib regression, and verify S1 postimages.
Verify all three S2 preimages; testautomation_stdlib.c must be S1 postimage 60c240c1cb452536716dc7d2896839ff95612fefac92efcaf2aa92ba6b2c3c77.
Apply the complete S2 patch and verify all S2 postimages. Do not apply S2 directly to pristine Stdlib or overwrite S1 with pristine source.

patch.includes: Exact upstream production hunk plus existing testautomation.c --no-init support and existing Stdlib allocation/cleanup regression, three files.

preserved.SDLPropertiesThreeCorrections: Exact SDL_properties.c pre/post hash unchanged; no unrelated Properties runtime repetition.
preserved.S1: SDL_string.c hash unchanged; UTF8 case body byteexact and prior Stdlib reference order retained; actual S1 117 assertions pass.
preserved.displayPolicies: Selected Cocoa and both engine bridge sources unchanged; no target-screen/safe-area/fullscreen code changes or display test needed.
preserved.launcherHEADIndex: Bounded exact checks unchanged; source checkpoint uses separate publisher, not real dirty index.
preserved.frozenApps: No repack/install/write. Selected frozen/root metadata and packaged SDL hashes unchanged; full inventories not rerun.
preserved.NoGSCUSNumericMPWaitCostAI: outside edited/built path; no engine/AI/graphics/Loader source or build touched.

sourcePublicABIScope: Production source ABI declarations, compile flags/cache and dependency load commands/install name unchanged; no new binary export census.
notClaimed: new binary export census or app integration/GPU/game/FPS/MP/IME/audio acceptance
license: Existing SDL source license and attribution remain in the pinned component archive.
appReleaseScope: Cumulative S1+S2 source/raw-component checkpoint only; no app, Release, Homebrew, V1 or tag change.
commitSHARule: Actual source publication commit is recorded afterward in a separate local receipt.
